messages:
Alex R.: Heads up — CrescentCare reached out asking to onboard a clinical summarizer (13B) that will handle PHI. They want Private deployment (VPC) + HSM key management. Customer said use cases: weekly batch summarization + live triage summaries. They estimate peak ~40 QPS, avg seq len ~512. They prefer int8 quantization for cost — need to confirm accuracy drop they can tolerate.

Maria G.: Got it. Do we have an existing PHI onboarding checklist? @Kelsey can you start the compliance intake and request DLP mappings + data flow diagrams? Need SOC2 contact too. :memo:

Kelsey: On it. I'll open the intake and schedule a 30m kickoff with CrescentCare + SEs. Proposed times: tomorrow 10am PT or Thu 2pm PT. @Priya which is better for SE side?

Priya S.: Thu 2pm PT works for me. For the model path: recommend a 13B finetuned on clinical notes with a redaction prefilter + hallucination detection post-check. Can they provide a small eval set (200-300 examples) focusing on edge PHI cases? Also need to confirm latency SLO — is 300ms p90 required for triage or can we accept 500ms?

Jamal T.: Quick infra note — 40 QPS at 300ms p90 implies sustained throughput ~12 tokens/ms depending on tokenization. Rough sizing: 2 x A100 or similar dedicated nodes with continuous batching. If they accept 500ms p90 we could try 1 node with aggressive batching and burst capacity. HSM/KMS adds ~10-30ms per key unwrap on cold start but keys are cached; not per-token.

Alex R.: CrescentCare replied: 300ms p90 is the target for live triage, batch jobs can be slower. They said they'll aim to deliver the eval set by EOD Fri. They also asked about canary rollouts, monitoring, and rollback.

Priya S.: We can do canary: start at 5% for 2 hours, then 25% for 24h, with automatic rollback if hallucination rate or summary QA drops past threshold. Proposed eval thresholds: ROUGE-L >= 0.72 on sanitized eval set AND hallucination rate < 2% on spot checks. Thoughts?

Kelsey: Adding those thresholds to the intake. Compliance also requested KMS ARN + name of SOC2 contact. I'll ask CrescentCare to provide both before the kickoff.

deploy-bot: Ticket created: CS-5021 CrescentCare PHI 13B onboarding. Assignees: Kelsey, Priya S., Jamal T. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/CS-5021

Alex R.: :thumbsup: Thanks team. Next steps: Kelsey to schedule kickoff and collect KMS/SOC2 info, Priya to prepare the model config & quantization notes, Jamal to sketch infra sizing and SLO tradeoffs. We'll sync after kickoff.

Maria G.: I'll follow up on renewal risk note — they mentioned multi-year budget if performance/cost numbers look good. Keep CS briefed. :eyes:
